description: Monumental chimney hearth, paired storage racks, butcher island and two long mess tables with benches.
differences: Underwater open fire replaced with unlit usable vanilla furnaces and water cauldron; no campfire/fire/lava hazard.

water_policy: Shallow contained display pools, raised dry traversable ports; no ocean placement survival claim.
